newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HSBC Asset Mgt names Chow deputy CEO.
newsitem.headline: HSBC Asset Mgt names Chow deputy CEO.

text.p: HSBC Asset Management said on Tuesday it has named Paul Chow, the former chief executive of the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong, to the new position of Deputy Chief Executive Officer in Hong Kong, effective April 1.
HSBC Asset Management is the global investment advisory and money management arm of HSBC Holdings Plc.
Chow will report directly to Robert Duggins, Chief Executive Officer - Asia Pacific, and functionally to Kevin Gregory, Global Chief Operating Officer, HSBC Asset Management said in a statement.

He will be responsible for ensuring that the operational and support functions of the company's Hong Kong businesses operate in an integrated fashion, as well as for the company's strategic development plans for Hong Kong, China, Taiwan and Korea.
Chow was chief executive of the Hong Kong bourse from 1991 until he retired on January 31. Prior to that he was chief executive of the Hong Kong Securities Clearing Co for two years.

"As a major fund management house, I believe that HSBC Asset Management is well positioned to realise its plans for expansion in the region, and I am very pleased to be joining the HSBC group in that effort," Chow said in a statement.
